sentences.zh: 嗨，我是安德鲁·罗斯-索尔金。

sentences.zh: 我负责《纽约时报》每日新闻通讯 Dealbook 的商业与政策报道。

sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》。

sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市的 Dealbook 峰会上现场采访一些商业、政治和文化领域最有影响力的领袖，包括 J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜

sentences.en: Lagarde, Zylran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the Dealbook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 拉加德、齐尔兰·蒙达尼以及许多其他人。

sentences.zh: 你可以实时观看其中一些毫无防备、未经过滤的对话。

sentences.zh: 11月18日，我们将在 nytimes.com 上免费直播精选访谈，供所有人观看。

sentences.zh: 如果您还不是订户，可以下载《纽约时报》应用程序进行观看，并获得我们所有新闻报道的一个月免费访问权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望大家准时收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你一定不想错过。

sentences.en: Hey, it's Sabrina.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是萨布丽娜。

sentences.en: This week, The Daily is revisiting some of our favorite episodes of the year and hearing what's happened in the Times since they first ran.
sentences.zh: 本周，《每日新闻》将重温我们今年最喜欢的一些节目，并了解《纽约时报》自这些节目首播以来发生的变化。

sentences.en: Today, we return to the moment in May when the nation was stunned by a leaked draft of a Supreme
sentences.zh: 今天，我们回到了五月份的那一刻，当时全国都被最高法院

sentences.en: Court opinion that previewed the end of Roe v.
sentences.zh: 意见草案的泄露震惊了，该草案预示着罗诉

sentences.en: Wade.
sentences.zh: 韦德案的终结。

sentences.en: After it came out, we spoke to people on both sides of the abortion fight.
sentences.zh: 事件发生后，我们采访了堕胎之争双方的人员。

sentences.en: Now, we're revisiting two of those conversations, one with an anti-abortion activist and the other with an abortion provider, to find out what's changed for them since the federal
sentences.zh: 现在，我们重新审视其中的两次对话，一次是与反堕胎活动人士的对话，另一次是与堕胎服务提供者的对话，以了解自从联邦

sentences.en: protection for abortion went away.
sentences.zh: 堕胎保护消失以来，他们的生活发生了什么变化。

sentences.en: It's Thursday, December 29th.
sentences.zh: 今天是12月29日，星期四。

sentences.en: My name is Anya Baker, and I'm 27.
sentences.zh: 我叫安雅·贝克，今年27岁。

sentences.en: I live in Jackson, Mississippi, and I am married.
sentences.zh: 我住在密西西比州杰克逊市，已婚。

sentences.en: I have two little boys.
sentences.zh: 我有两个小男孩。

sentences.en: One is three, one is one-year-old, and my one-year-old has multiple disabilities.
sentences.zh: 一个三岁，一个一岁，我的一岁儿子有多重残疾。

sentences.en: And the organization I work with now is the Susan B.
sentences.zh: 我现在合作的组织是苏珊·B.

sentences.en: Anthony List Education Fund, which expands across many services.
sentences.zh: 安东尼名单教育基金会，其业务涵盖许多服务。

sentences.en: So what this means is not just explicitly pro-life centers, but also groups that just assist along the way, whether that be a prenatal chiropractor, lactation, transportation,
sentences.zh: 这意味着不仅有明确支持生命的中心，还有沿途提供协助的团体，无论是产前脊椎按摩师、哺乳、交通、

sentences.en: housing, addiction recovery, basically anything and everything that can affect a woman who is
sentences.zh: 住房、戒毒康复，基本上任何和所有能影响怀孕或育儿女性的事情，并在这些领域寻找资源并将它们汇集在一起。

sentences.en: pregnant or parenting and try to find resources in those worlds and bring them together.
sentences.zh: 处于孕期或育儿期，并试图在这些领域寻找资源并将它们整合在一起。

sentences.en: So I got involved at 15 years old.
sentences.zh: 所以我15岁就参与进去了。

sentences.en: Often you will hear people say, I grew up in a home where we were just pro-life from the beginning.
sentences.zh: 你经常会听到人们说，我从小就在一个从一开始就反堕胎的家庭长大。

sentences.en: Many women in my family, I have a Hispanic family, have experienced abortion.
sentences.zh: 我家族中的许多女性，我是西班牙裔家庭，都经历过堕胎。

sentences.en: Not all of them are on the same page about what they think abortion policy should be.
sentences.zh: 并不是所有人对堕胎政策应该是什么样都有相同的看法。

sentences.en: But this came upon me, and I think even my family members who find themselves pro-choice are
sentences.zh: 但这件事落到了我头上，我想即使是我那些发现自己支持堕胎权的家人，也

sentences.en: appreciative of the side of the movement that I've been able to expose them to, which is legitimately caring and legitimately meeting needs.
sentences.zh: 欣赏我能让他们接触到的运动的那一面，那是合法地关怀和合法地满足需求。

sentences.en: Interesting.
sentences.zh: 有趣。

sentences.en: But Anya, I want to go back to when you were 15, because I guess in my mind, I'm thinking, why would a 15-year-old get so interested in this?
sentences.zh: 但安雅，我想回到你15岁的时候，因为我想在我的脑海里想，为什么一个15岁的孩子会对这个这么感兴趣？

sentences.en: You know, I mean, you could be, I don't know, going to the mall, playing video games, being a 15-year-old.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我的意思是，你可以去购物中心，玩电子游戏，做一个15岁的孩子。

sentences.en: Like, why such a serious topic for you at that age?
sentences.zh: 为什么在那个年龄对你来说这是一个如此严肃的话题？

sentences.en: Like, bring me back to that moment.
sentences.zh: 带我回到那一刻。

sentences.en: Well, Mississippi has some of the highest unplanned pregnancy rates, some of the highest teen pregnancy rates, as you probably have heard before.
sentences.zh: 嗯，正如你之前可能听说的那样，密西西比州拥有一些最高的意外怀孕率和一些最高的青少年怀孕率。

sentences.en: And I did have peers who had become pregnant or who had considered abortion or adoption or parented young.
sentences.zh: 我确实有一些同龄人怀孕了，或者考虑过堕胎、收养或年轻时抚养孩子。

sentences.en: I had seen it myself.
sentences.zh: 我自己亲眼见过。

sentences.en: And I recall a friend reaching out to me, I believe, when I was 15 and she was 16.
sentences.zh: 我记得有一个朋友联系我，我想我当时15岁，她16岁。

sentences.en: And why she called me, I don't really know.
sentences.zh: 她为什么打电话给我，我真的不知道。

sentences.en: You could call that divine providence.
sentences.zh: 你可以称之为天意。

sentences.en: You could just call it the rapport we had.
sentences.zh: 你也可以称之为我们之间的默契。

sentences.en: But I needed to know where to send her.
sentences.zh: 但我需要知道把她送到哪里。

sentences.en: And so when this came across my, you would say my desk, but I was 15.
sentences.zh: 所以当这件事来到我的，你会说是我的办公桌，但我当时15岁。

sentences.en: So, you know, in plain view for me, I knew, okay, this is going to keep happening.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，在我显眼的地方，我知道，好吧，这会继续发生。

sentences.en: I'm going to need to know where to send people.
sentences.zh: 我需要知道把人们送到哪里。

sentences.en: And she was able to connect with a student group and a church that helped her with childcare, that people supplied me with items to drive down to give her.
sentences.zh: 她能够联系到一个学生团体和一个教堂，帮助她照顾孩子，人们提供给我物品让我开车送去给她。

sentences.en: And stories like that have sprung up time after time, all across our state.
sentences.zh: 像这样的故事一次又一次地在我们整个州涌现。

sentences.en: You mentioned, Anya, that this question kept popping up.
sentences.zh: 安雅，你提到过这个问题不断出现。

sentences.en: I mean, were there a lot of young women in your life, girls in your life in school, who this happened to?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，在你的生活中，在学校里，有很多年轻女性、女孩经历过这种事吗？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And especially in college, many, many women that I went to school with or found are pregnant on campus club would come to us.
sentences.zh: 特别是在大学里，许多和我一起上学或发现校园里怀孕俱乐部的女性会来找我们。

sentences.en: We had a baby shower for student parents at
sentences.zh: 我们为

sentences.en: Mississippi State that first served 15 student parents.
sentences.zh: 密西西比州立大学的学生父母举办了一场婴儿派对，最初为15位学生父母服务。

sentences.en: And then the next year doubled to 30 student parents.
sentences.zh: 然后第二年翻倍到了30位学生父母。

sentences.en: Do you have a memory, Anya, of anyone you were working with during those times who was struggling with the choice of whether to have an abortion?
sentences.zh: 安雅，你还记得在那个时期与你合作过的人中，有谁在是否堕胎的选择上挣扎吗？

sentences.en: I mean, was that ever come up for you?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，你遇到过这种情况吗？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I had a very good friend to this day who I barely knew in high school who reached out to me
sentences.zh: 直到今天，我还有一个非常好的朋友，高中时我几乎不认识她，她联系了我，

sentences.en: because she had seen me posting on social media about if you ever need support or resources to reach out.
sentences.zh: 因为她看到我在社交媒体上发帖说，如果你需要支持或资源，请联系。

sentences.en: And she took the better part of an entire month to make her decision because she knew she was pregnant pretty early on.
sentences.zh: 她花了大半个月的时间来做决定，因为她很早就知道自己怀孕了。

sentences.en: She had a big window to obtain an abortion.
sentences.zh: 她有很长的时间窗口来堕胎。

sentences.en: And she really was
sentences.zh: 她真的在

sentences.en: grappling with her own decision.
sentences.zh: 纠结自己的决定。

sentences.en: And of course, I want her to make her own decision and tell me what she needs.
sentences.zh: 当然，我希望她自己做决定并告诉我她需要什么。

sentences.en: I want to serve her in the way that she wants to be served.
sentences.zh: 我想以她希望被服务的方式为她服务。

sentences.en: And really, she wanted to parent her child, but she was worried about a number of things like, will my parents accept me?
sentences.zh: 实际上，她想抚养她的孩子，但她担心很多事情，比如，我的父母会接受我吗？

sentences.en: This child was not going to be just white.
sentences.zh: 这个孩子不只是白人。

sentences.en: Were there going to be racial tensions around the fact that her child was mixed race?
sentences.zh: 她的孩子是混血儿这件事周围会有种族紧张关系吗？

sentences.en: And that's something she had to confront within her own family.
sentences.zh: 这是她必须在自己家庭内部面对的事情。

sentences.en: And was she going to have what she needed financially or where was she going to live?
sentences.zh: 她有经济上需要的支持吗，或者她将住在哪里？

sentences.en: And so these are the things we had to walk through together.
sentences.zh: 所以这些都是我们必须一起经历的事情。

sentences.en: And I think it's completely understandable to be afraid in any of those scenarios.
sentences.zh: 我认为在任何这些情况下感到害怕都是完全可以理解的。

sentences.en: You wanted her to make her own decision, but would it have been hard to support her if that decision was abortion?
sentences.zh: 你想让她自己做决定，但如果这个决定是堕胎，支持她会很难吗？

sentences.en: I would have not driven her to an abortion.
sentences.zh: 我不会开车送她去堕胎。

sentences.en: I would have not given her information to obtain an abortion.
sentences.zh: 我不会给她提供堕胎的信息。

sentences.en: But oftentimes, women need support emotionally after they make that choice.
sentences.zh: 但通常情况下，女性在做出选择后需要在情感上得到支持。

sentences.en: And so I would be able to point her towards professionals who can help her piece out the maybe complex emotions she's having.
sentences.zh: 所以我能够引导她去找专业人士，帮助她梳理她可能有的复杂情绪。

sentences.en: And she ended up parenting her child, who is a beautiful little boy to this day.
sentences.zh: 她最终抚养了她的孩子，直到今天，他还是一个漂亮的小男孩。

sentences.en: She went on to marry a man who has become dad to that little boy.
sentences.zh: 她后来嫁给了一个成为那个小男孩父亲的男人。

sentences.en: And she's had two more children and started her own business.
sentences.zh: 她又生了两个孩子，并创办了自己的企业。

sentences.en: And she says all the time that when she was, I believe,
sentences.zh: 她一直说，当她，我相信，

sentences.en: 17 at the time, she saw no future for herself.
sentences.zh: 当时17岁时，她看不到自己的未来。

sentences.en: She thought that perhaps abortion was the only way for her to find happiness.
sentences.zh: 她认为堕胎可能是她找到幸福的唯一途径。

sentences.en: And I've seen her bloom and help other women in her own same situation later on.
sentences.zh: 我看着她绽放，后来又去帮助和她处境相同的其他女性。

sentences.en: How did you see your work?
sentences.zh: 你是如何看待你的工作的？

sentences.en: Do you think of yourself as a feminist?
sentences.zh: 你认为自己是一个女权主义者吗？

sentences.en: I do.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I think that the goal of feminism is to elevate women.
sentences.zh: 我认为女权主义的目标是提升女性。

sentences.en: And I don't believe the vision of feminism includes removing the reproductive quality of a woman.
sentences.zh: 我不认为女权主义的愿景包括剥夺女性的生育能力。

sentences.en: I believe that society needs to take women for all that they are and not treat their fertility like a disease.
sentences.zh: 我认为社会需要接受女性的全部，而不是把她们的生育能力当作一种疾病。

sentences.en: Anya, do you feel embraced as a feminist or do you feel like you have been rejected by other feminists?
sentences.zh: 安雅，你觉得自己作为女权主义者被接纳了吗，还是觉得自己被其他女权主义者排斥了？

sentences.en: I know there are times where pro-life feminist friends of mine have been, for instance, disinvited to the Women's March.
sentences.zh: 我知道有时我的反堕胎女权主义朋友，例如，被取消了女性游行的邀请。

sentences.en: I know that in college, when I said I was writing for a pro-life feminist publication, I had a professor say, well, that's kind of an oxymoron, isn't it?
sentences.zh: 我知道在大学里，当我说是为一个反堕胎女权主义出版物写稿时，有个教授说，这有点像自相矛盾，不是吗？

sentences.en: So I understand that there's rejection involved, but I'm fully embraced by the communities that I want an embrace from.
sentences.zh: 所以我理解其中存在排斥，但我得到了我想要接纳我的社区的完全接纳。

sentences.en: And so I ultimately don't feel rejected.
sentences.zh: 所以我最终并没有感到被排斥。

sentences.en: Where were you, Anya, when you heard the news about the leak of the draft from the
sentences.zh: 安雅，当听到最高法院草案泄露的消息时，

sentences.en: Supreme Court?
sentences.zh: 你在哪里？

sentences.en: I was actually nursing my baby, just sitting at home with my family.
sentences.zh: 我当时实际上在给我的孩子喂奶，正和家人坐在家里。

sentences.en: And we just, everyone was, I'm sure as in your world, was texting and calling each other, trying to find out if this was legitimate, what it means, has this happened before?
sentences.zh: 我们只是，每个人都在，我敢肯定就像在你们的世界里一样，互相发短信和打电话，试图弄清楚这是否合法，这意味着什么，以前发生过这种事吗？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I don't feel it's the time yet to make toast, but I feel hopeful.
sentences.zh: 我觉得现在还不是庆祝的时候，但我感到希望。

sentences.en: So I think that's where I have to reside until
sentences.zh: 所以我想这就是我必须停留的地方，直到

sentences.en: we have more information.
sentences.zh: 我们有更多信息。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: You're referring to the fact that it's just a draft.
sentences.zh: 你指的是这只是一份草案的事实。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And I think time and time again, you know, different challenges have come to the Supreme
sentences.zh: 我认为一次又一次地，你知道，不同的挑战来到了最高

sentences.en: Court.
sentences.zh: 法院。

sentences.en: And being in Mississippi, knowing that the challenge is coming from our own state, I think Mississippi sometimes can be the butt of jokes.
sentences.zh: 身在密西西比州，知道挑战来自我们自己的州，我认为密西西比州有时会成为笑柄。

sentences.en: And to be able to set a precedent like this that sets free all of the states who've been working on the same things that we have is historical.
sentences.zh: 能够树立这样一个先例，解放所有一直在做与我们同样事情的州，这是历史性的。

sentences.en: It makes you feel like you're experiencing something that is going to be written about, or in this instance, recorded for us to understand for years to come.
sentences.zh: 这让你觉得你正在经历一些将被书写的事情，或者在这种情况下，被记录下来供我们在未来几年理解。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: That in a way, it's your home state that made the history.
sentences.zh: 某种程度上，是你的家乡创造了历史。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I'm really proud.
sentences.zh: 我真的很自豪。

sentences.en: This was built by regular people.
sentences.zh: 这是由普通人建立的。

sentences.en: So to see that opinion reflected in the major core of opinion is really encouraging because we feel seen.
sentences.zh: 因此，看到这种意见反映在主要的核心意见中真的令人鼓舞，因为我们觉得自己被看到了。

sentences.en: You feel seen.
sentences.zh: 你觉得被看到了。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: Anya, thank you so much for talking to us.
sentences.zh: 安雅，非常感谢你接受我们的采访。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 不客气。

sentences.en: Recently, my colleague, senior producer Jessica Chung, called Anya back to see what's changed in her life since Roe was overturned.
sentences.zh: 最近，我的同事、高级制作人杰西卡·钟（Jessica Chung）回访了安雅，看看自罗诉韦德案被推翻以来她的生活发生了什么变化。

sentences.en: Hi, Anya.
sentences.zh: 嗨，安雅。

sentences.en: Hi.
sentences.zh: 嗨。

sentences.en: Can you hear me okay?
sentences.zh: 你能听清我说话吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, I can hear you fine.
sentences.zh: 听得清，我听得很清楚。

sentences.en: Great.
sentences.zh: 太好了。

sentences.en: Well, it's great to connect with you.
sentences.zh: 很高兴能与你联系。

sentences.en: How are you?
sentences.zh: 你好吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, I'm pretty good.
sentences.zh: 挺好的。

sentences.en: It's actually my birthday, so it's a fun day to talk about my work and round out my year.
sentences.zh: 今天实际上是我的生日，所以谈论我的工作并为我的这一年画上句号是个有趣的日子。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: Happy birthday, December 15th.
sentences.zh: 生日快乐，12月15日。

sentences.en: How old are you?
sentences.zh: 你多大？

sentences.en: I'm 28 today.
sentences.zh: 我今天28岁了。

sentences.en: Oh, wow.
sentences.zh: 哦，哇。

sentences.en: So we want to connect with you because when we last talked to you, the draft of the Supreme
sentences.zh: 我们想联系你，因为当我们上次和你交谈时，最高法院关于罗诉韦德案意见的草案刚刚泄露，你对此深受鼓舞。

sentences.en: Court opinion on Roe had just leaked, and you were really encouraged by that.
sentences.zh: 关于罗诉韦德案的法院意见刚刚泄露，你对此深受鼓舞。

sentences.en: Can you describe where you were when you actually heard the ruling?
sentences.zh: 你能描述一下你听到裁决时的情景吗？

sentences.en: I was just at home, and I was by myself.
sentences.zh: 我当时在家，而且我独自一人。

sentences.en: No one was at home with me, and I was on the phone with my colleague, and so we read at the same time an organization-wide message, and I read it out like a shock.
sentences.zh: 家里没有别人，我正在和同事通电话，所以我们同时阅读了一条全组织的消息，我惊讶得读了出来。

sentences.en: Even though it was a decision a lot of people were anticipating, the pro-life side
sentences.zh: 尽管这是一个许多人都在期待的决定，但反堕胎阵营

sentences.en: almost wins with the cards held close to our cheSt. Like, don't get too excited.
sentences.zh: 赢得很谨慎，就像牌握在胸前一样。就像，不要太兴奋。

sentences.en: Don't celebrate too much.
sentences.zh: 不要庆祝得太多。

sentences.en: Don't get your hopes up.
sentences.zh: 别抱太大希望。

sentences.en: But I had a friend who all year was saying, you get your hopes up.
sentences.zh: 但我有个朋友一整年都在说，你要抱希望。

sentences.en: So I tried to internalize some of that, but until the moment happened, I didn't realize how much I
sentences.zh: 所以我试着去消化其中的一部分，但直到那一刻发生，我才意识到我

sentences.en: really was holding close, maybe an emotional safeguard for if things don't go the way that we want.
sentences.zh: 内心其实紧紧抓着不放，也许是一种情感上的防线，以防事情不如我们所愿。

sentences.en: And in that moment, you felt like you could finally let yourself have that feeling kind of sink in that you wouldn't allow yourself to have before this moment.
sentences.zh: 而在那一刻，你觉得你终于可以让自己去体会那种感觉，让它沉淀下来，这是在这之前你不允许自己去感受的。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I'll say it was brief because even just minutes or hours after, okay, it's time to get to work.
sentences.zh: 我说它短暂是因为哪怕只是在几分钟或几小时后，好吧，就该开始干活了。

sentences.en: It's time to make sure people have what they need.
sentences.zh: 是时候确保人们拥有他们所需的东西了。

sentences.en: It's not like, now it's time to sit back and relax, and we win for all time.
sentences.zh: 这并不是说，现在可以坐下来放松，我们彻底胜利了。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: I have to imagine that your work has gotten a lot more busy since Roe was overturned,
sentences.zh: 我能想象自从罗诉韦德案被推翻后，你的工作变得忙碌了许多，

sentences.en: that you're meeting more people, more women who are keeping their pregnancies who will need your help.
sentences.zh: 你遇到了更多人，更多决定继续怀孕、需要你帮助的女性。

sentences.en: Is that right?
sentences.zh: 是这样吗？

sentences.en: Is that reflective of what you're seeing with your job?
sentences.zh: 这反映了你工作中的现状吗？

sentences.en: I myself don't do the case management of women.
sentences.zh: 我自己不负责女性的个案管理。

sentences.en: So I communicate with the providers in the different service areas, and they are telling me what they're seeing more of.
sentences.zh: 所以我与不同服务领域的供应商沟通，他们告诉我他们看到更多的是什么。

sentences.en: So before we were talking about something a little more abstract, something that may become an uptick in their community.
sentences.zh: 所以在之前，我们谈论的是一些比较抽象的事情，一些可能在他们社区里会增加的事情。

sentences.en: Okay, now we're talking about something that really is happening, and that actually has made my job easier as far as explaining
sentences.zh: 好吧，现在我们谈论的是真正正在发生的事情，这实际上让我的工作变得更轻松了，就解释

sentences.en: what it is we do and what our goal is to have a more seamless referral process.
sentences.zh: 我们做的是什么以及我们的目标是建立一个更无缝的转诊流程而言。

sentences.en: So you're seeing more resources, like more services being offered because of the demand of women who are now keeping their pregnancies.
sentences.zh: 所以由于现在选择继续怀孕的女性的需求，你看到了更多的资源，比如提供了更多的服务。

sentences.en: I would say the initial uptick in resources has actually been led by community organization leaders and church leaders who have heard from their
sentences.zh: 我想说，最初资源的增长实际上是由社区组织领导人和教会领导人带头的，他们听到了来自

sentences.en: congregation or their members who have said, I'm so glad this happened.
sentences.zh: 会众或成员的声音，他们说，我很高兴这件事发生了。

sentences.en: Hooray.
sentences.zh: 太好了。

sentences.en: But what are we doing?
sentences.zh: 但我们在做什么？

sentences.en: What are we doing at our church?
sentences.zh: 我们在自己的教堂里在做什么？

sentences.en: What are we doing at our club?
sentences.zh: 我们在自己的俱乐部里在做什么？

sentences.en: And so oftentimes then they're pointed back to me or someone calls me up with an idea.
sentences.zh: 所以很多时候，他们会来找我，或者有人带着想法给我打电话。

sentences.en: An example would be I've heard of multiple pastors, especially pastors of children's programs, saying, well, we have a preschool here.
sentences.zh: 一个例子是，我听说过好几位牧师，尤其是儿童事工的牧师说，我们在那儿有个学前班。

sentences.en: We have a daycare here at the church.
sentences.zh: 我们在教堂里有一个日托中心。

sentences.en: How many spots can we open up?
sentences.zh: 我们可以腾出多少个名额？

sentences.en: Let's talk about that.
sentences.zh: 我们来谈谈这个。

sentences.en: But I'm really not having to beg people to get involved.
sentences.zh: 但我真的不需要求别人参与。

sentences.en: It's their own communities that are holding them accountable.
sentences.zh: 是他们自己的社区在约束他们。

sentences.en: They have made sure, okay, we've been praying for this a long time, and now here it is.
sentences.zh: 他们确保，好吧，我们为此祈祷了很久，现在它终于来了。

sentences.en: And so what is the thing that I'm a member of doing?
sentences.zh: 那么我所属的组织在做什么呢？

sentences.en: Do you have a sense of how many more women with pregnancies that would have resulted in abortions
sentences.zh: 你知不知道，那些原本会选择堕胎、

sentences.en: are now not, meaning how many more women you have to serve because of Roe being overturned and now they're having to keep their pregnancies?
sentences.zh: 而现在没有堕胎的孕妇究竟有多少？也就是说，因为罗诉韦德案被推翻、现在她们不得不继续怀孕，你必须服务更多的女性，具体有多少？

sentences.en: I don't because while we do have this statewide data from previous years, we don't have the data of all the states that women previously went to.
sentences.zh: 我不知道，因为虽然我们有往年的全州数据，但我们没有女性以前去过的所有州的数据。

sentences.en: For instance, DeSoto counties on the border of Tennessee,
sentences.zh: 例如，德索托县位于田纳西州边界，

sentences.en: Tennessee, perhaps a lot of people fall into the Tennessee numbers.
sentences.zh: 田纳西州，也许很多人都被统计到了田纳西州的数据里。

sentences.en: I think what's most helpful is pulling that county-by-county data and saying that this is at least how many we anticipate in your county.
sentences.zh: 我认为最有用的做法是提取各县的数据，并说这至少是我们在你们县预测的人数。

sentences.en: And is there a county you have projections for that you're working with?
sentences.zh: 有没有哪个县是你正在研究并做出了预测的？

sentences.en: I was talking with someone in Madison County, which is pretty close to me.
sentences.zh: 我曾和麦迪逊县的一个人交谈过，离我挺近的。

sentences.en: The data was around 200.
sentences.zh: 数据大约是 200 人。

sentences.en: 200 women whose pregnancy may have resulted in abortions but are now not.
sentences.zh: 200 名原本可能会堕胎但现在没有堕胎的女性。

sentences.en: Potentially.
sentences.zh: 潜在的。

sentences.en: Potentially.
sentences.zh: 潜在的。

sentences.en: That is something we talked about when we're actually projecting how many spots for daycare might be available.
sentences.zh: 这是我们在实际预测日托中心可能提供多少名额时会讨论的内容。

sentences.en: What makes projections like this difficult to be precise on is we don't know how many women are choosing adoption.
sentences.zh: 让这种预测难以精确的原因是，我们不知道有多少女性会选择收养。

sentences.en: We don't know how many women are finding a way to work part-time and arrange child care with a parent, for instance.
sentences.zh: 我们不知道有多少女性会想方设法去做兼职，并比如跟父母商量安排育儿事宜。

sentences.en: These are early days.
sentences.zh: 现在还为时过早。

sentences.en: So really any numbers would be a projection, a guess.
sentences.zh: 所以实际上任何数字都只是预测，是猜测。

sentences.en: And the best we can do is, like I said, plan and anticipate based on what comes next.
sentences.zh: 我们能做的最好的事情就是，就像我说的，根据接下来发生的事情进行规划和预测。

sentences.en: I know 200 is just a projection and you're only working with projections at this point.
sentences.zh: 我知道 200 只是一个预测，你目前也只能根据预测工作。

sentences.en: But do you ever worry that you and the providers might not ever be able to keep up with the demand?
sentences.zh: 但你有没有担心过，你和供应商可能永远无法满足这种需求？

sentences.en: Well, we know that no two women's stories are the same.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我们知道没有两个女性的故事是相同的。

sentences.en: And so every single woman is not going to need every single thing.
sentences.zh: 所以并不是每单个女性都需要每一样东西。

sentences.en: I hear what you're saying about, do I worry that there won't be enough of a specific resource or multiple resources?
sentences.zh: 我明白你的意思，你是问我是否担心某种特定资源或多种资源会不够用？

sentences.en: The reason I have so much faith in my community is because I get to see it from the receiving end.
sentences.zh: 我对社区抱有如此大的信心的原因，是因为我有机会从接受端看到这一切。

sentences.en: So while every provider does say, hey, we could use more hands, we could use more toiletries, we could use more presents for Christmas this year, I see every single day
sentences.zh: 因此，虽然每个供应商都确实说过，嘿，我们需要更多人手，我们需要更多日用品，我们需要今年圣诞节能有更多礼物，但我每天都看到

sentences.en: these needs fulfilled that usually start out feeling way too big.
sentences.zh: 这些需求得到了满足，而这些需求一开始往往让人觉得庞大得无法应对。

sentences.en: I mean, I'm in these groups for foster and adoption support.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我在这些寄养和收养支持群里。

sentences.en: And sometimes the needs are posted in a community group.
sentences.zh: 有时需求会被发布在社区群里。

sentences.en: And honestly, I can't even get to help before the community comes through.
sentences.zh: 老实说，甚至在轮到我帮忙之前，社区就已经伸出援手了。

sentences.en: I'm really optimistic and I'm ready to see what happens in the spring.
sentences.zh: 我真的很乐观，我准备好看看今年春天会发生什么了。

sentences.en: I think that the world is going to be pleasantly surprised once the babies are here.
sentences.zh: 我认为一旦婴儿出生，世界将会得到一个惊喜。

sentences.en: And that's not to say there won't be struggles and we won't be learning along the way what to do better, what there's a need to have more of.
sentences.zh: 这并不是说不会有困难，我们不会在摸索中学习如何做得更好、什么东西需要更多。

sentences.en: But I think we have to get back to that mother and child
sentences.zh: 但我认为我们必须回归到那位母亲和孩子身上，

sentences.en: and meet each of them where they're at in a really human way.
sentences.zh: 以一种非常人性化的方式去满足他们各自的需求。

sentences.en: And I think seeing the children will change things for a lot of people.
sentences.zh: 我认为看到这些孩子会改变许多人的看法。

sentences.en: After the break, we revisit the other side of the abortion fight.
sentences.zh: 休息过后，我们将重新审视堕胎之争的另一面。

sentences.zh: 堕胎服务提供者。

sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》App？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 解锁版？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to The Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 众所周知，你需要订阅《时报》才能阅读所有报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore The Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但如果你可以免费试用《时报》一个月，而且不需要输入信用卡信息呢？

sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.zh: 当你首次下载《纽约时报》App 时，你在该应用里的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 有一个月的时间可以突破付费墙，看看《时报》订阅者每天都能获得什么。

sentences.zh: 如果你还没有订阅《纽约时报》，请立即下载《时报》App，即可获得 30 天的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: So Jessica, by the way, is it okay if I call you Jess?
sentences.zh: 那么杰西卡，顺便问一下，我叫你杰丝（Jess）可以吗？

sentences.en: Do you prefer Dr. Rubino?
sentences.zh: 你更喜欢被叫鲁比诺医生吗？

sentences.en: How do you prefer I address you?
sentences.zh: 你希望我怎么称呼你？

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So I'm Dr. Jessica Rubino, and I work at Austin Women's
sentences.zh: 我是杰西卡·鲁比诺医生，我在奥斯汀妇女

sentences.en: Health Center.
sentences.zh: 健康中心工作。

sentences.en: I've been there for about four years.
sentences.zh: 我在那里大约四年了。

sentences.en: I've been doing abortions for a little bit longer than that, almost five years, I think, at this point.
sentences.zh: 我做堕胎手术的时间比这稍微长一点，我想目前快五年了。

sentences.en: I am going to be 37 years old this summer
sentences.zh: 我今年夏天就 37 岁了，

sentences.en: and have been just practicing under all those other restrictions that made me mad, the 24-hour waiting period and the script of things that aren't true and blah, blah, blah.
sentences.zh: 一直在那些让我生气的其他限制下行医，比如 24 小时等待期、那些不实之词的稿本，等等等等。

sentences.en: And that all lasted until
sentences.zh: 这一切一直持续到

sentences.en: September.
sentences.zh: 九月。

sentences.en: And then September started and we entered a new kind of hell.
sentences.zh: 然后九月开始了，我们进入了一种新的炼狱。

sentences.en: We are only allowed to provide roughly up until six weeks.
sentences.zh: 我们只被允许大致在怀孕六周以内提供服务。

sentences.en: And that's SBA, the six-week ban, right, Jess?
sentences.zh: 那是 SBA，六周禁令，对吧，杰丝？

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So not only do we have to wade through the stress of feeling like, okay, are you too far?
sentences.zh: 所以我们不仅要承受这种心理压力：好吧，你怀孕时间是不是太久了？

sentences.en: Are you not?
sentences.zh: 还是没有？

sentences.en: But even if they are okay and they're under the limit and I say, yes, I can see you, even them, they are like, okay, well, I don't know if I even want to have an abortion yet.
sentences.zh: 但即使她们符合条件、在限制周数内，我说，好的，我可以为你面诊，即便如此，她们也会说，好吧，我甚至还不知道自己到底想不想堕胎。

sentences.en: Some patients have told us that they feel so rushed in their choice, but they had to come to the clinic to get their
sentences.zh: 一些患者告诉我们，她们在做选择时感到非常仓促，但她们不得不来诊所进行

sentences.en: consultation just in case because we also have the 24-hour waiting period.
sentences.zh: 咨询以防万一，因为我们还有 24 小时等待期。

sentences.en: I had a patient yesterday who said, I wish I could just be in peace while I'm making this decision because right now every social
sentences.zh: 我昨天有一位患者说，我真希望在做这个决定时能获得内心的平静，因为现在到处都是社交

sentences.en: media feed everywhere, this is everywhere, and I just happen to be pregnant during this time.
sentences.zh: 媒体动态，到处都是这个，而我偏偏在这个时候怀孕了。

sentences.en: And she's someone that I'm going to be able to see.
sentences.zh: 她是我能够接诊的患者之一。

sentences.en: She's early enough, but it's still so overwhelming for her to try to actually know what she really wants to do aside from all the crap around us.
sentences.zh: 她发现得够早，但要在我们身边所有的乱七八糟的事情之外，真正弄清楚自己到底想做什么，对她来说依然是压力山大。

sentences.en: Jess, what happens when a patient comes to you and you have to tell them that they're beyond six weeks?
sentences.zh: 杰丝，当一个患者来找你，而你不得不告诉她们已经超过六周时，会发生什么？

sentences.en: Once I tell them that they're beyond six weeks, that they're past the point, some patients just sit up and swear a lot.
sentences.zh: 一旦我告诉她们已经超过六周，已经过了那个时间点，有些患者就会坐起身来，狠狠地骂脏话。

sentences.en: And they're like, it's not at you.
sentences.zh: 然后她们会说，我不是冲你发火。

sentences.en: I just can't believe that this is even happening.
sentences.zh: 我只是不敢相信这居然真的发生了。

sentences.en: Other patients, it's complete fear.
sentences.zh: 其他患者则是感到彻底的恐惧。

sentences.en: I had a patient who just sat up and started crying the other day and said, well, I mean, if I don't get an abortion, my partner said they're going to kill me.
sentences.zh: 前几天我有一个患者，她直接坐起来开始哭，说，好吧，我是说，如果我不去堕胎，我的伴侣说他会杀了我的。

sentences.en: What am I supposed to do?
sentences.zh: 我该怎么办？

sentences.en: And what am I supposed to tell them?
sentences.zh: 我又该对他们说什么？

sentences.en: I can't offer you the appropriate medical care in this situation if that's what you want.
sentences.zh: 如果这就是你想要的，在这种情况下，我无法为你提供合适的医疗护理。

sentences.en: If you want to terminate your pregnancy in this situation for your safety, you don't have the ability to do that.
sentences.zh: 如果你想为了自身安全在这种情况下终止妊娠，你没有能力做到这一点。

sentences.en: So she matters so much less than the pregnancy.
sentences.zh: 所以她的重要性远远比不上那个胎儿。

sentences.en: What did you say to her?
sentences.zh: 你对她说了什么？

sentences.en: I literally like, okay, I have resources.
sentences.zh: 我简直是，好吧，我有资源。

sentences.en: Take a few breaths.
sentences.zh: 做几个深呼吸。

sentences.en: Let's not give up.
sentences.zh: 我们不要放弃。

sentences.en: Here's what we need to do.
sentences.zh: 这是我们需要做的。

sentences.en: And then I'm able, at least currently, I'm able to give her resources to get one legally outside of the state.
sentences.zh: 然后我能够，至少目前我还能够，给她提供资源，让她去州外合法堕胎。

sentences.en: And for someone who's just disclosed something like that, her brain is in three other places and she's freaking out.
sentences.zh: 对于一个刚透露了这种事情的人来说，她的脑子同时在想其他三件事，她快崩溃了。

sentences.en: But I also, I have to bring her back down to earth a little bit in that moment and be like, okay, but what are we going to do practically?
sentences.zh: 但我也必须在那一刻把她拉回现实一点，对她说，好吧，但从实际角度出发我们该怎么做？

sentences.en: What are you going to do?
sentences.zh: 你打算怎么做？

sentences.en: Here are the steps.
sentences.zh: 步骤如下。

sentences.en: I mean, it's like you're watching kind of the doors closing in real time and having to game it out like some, I don't know, army general or something.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这就好比你眼睁睁看着大门实时关上，然后你得像个什么，我不知道，陆军将军一样去推演它。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: We have patients who, I had one two weeks ago.
sentences.zh: 我们有这样的患者，两周前我接诊过一个。

sentences.en: That day was really, really hard to be a provider was when she said, but this pregnancy wasn't a choice.

sentences.en: And I just was really, really just so happy that whole week.
sentences.zh: 显然，度假时比上班时要快乐，对某些人来说是这样。

sentences.en: And obviously, on vacation, you're happier than when you're at work for some people.
sentences.zh: 但实际上，以前我休假时还会想念我的工作。

sentences.en: But actually, like, I used to miss my job when I'd be on vacation.
sentences.zh: 我是真的很热爱我的工作。

sentences.en: Like, I really love my work.
sentences.zh: 而回来后，那种压抑感扑面而来，就像，

sentences.en: And coming back and the oppression of it immediately, like,
sentences.zh: 我说，我再也干不下去了。

sentences.en: I said, I can't do it anymore.
sentences.zh: 就在我回去第一天的中午左右。

sentences.en: It was just like midway through my day that first day back.
sentences.zh: 我简直，我没法活了。

sentences.en: And I just, I can't live.
sentences.zh: 这根本无法维持。

sentences.en: This is untenable.
sentences.zh: 既然我无法做我觉得正确的事，此时此刻，我就无法凭良心以人们可以凭良心拒绝的方式提供堕胎服务。

sentences.en: And since I can't do what I feel is right, right now, I can't conscientiously provide abortion in the way that people can conscientiously refuse.
sentences.zh: 只是无法再呆在那里了。

sentences.en: Just couldn't be there anymore.
sentences.zh: 杰丝，你有没有想过，去一个得克萨斯州女性会去的州，比如边境州？

sentences.en: Did you think, Jess, of maybe going to a state, like a border state where women from Texas were going?
sentences.zh: 在你决定离开之后，你的心路历程是怎样的？

sentences.en: Like, what was your thought process after you decided to leave?
sentences.zh: 我考虑过。

sentences.en: I considered it.
sentences.zh: 事实上，在我突然开始在其他地方提供服务之间，存在着令人惊讶的重重障碍。

sentences.en: There were actually a surprising number of barriers between
sentences.zh: 事实上，在我突然决定去别的地方提供服务之间

sentences.en: me just suddenly starting to provide somewhere else.
sentences.zh: 存在着数量惊人的障碍。

sentences.en: Let's say, okay, I moved to Colorado,
sentences.zh: 比如说，好吧，我搬到了科罗拉多州，

sentences.en: Colorado, and I worked for someone or I set up my own clinic, because I definitely thought of that.
sentences.zh: 科罗拉多州，我为别人打工或者自己开个诊所，因为我确实考虑过这一点。

sentences.en: But then what if the Colorado legislature flips and becomes Republican and I can't do abortions there?
sentences.zh: 但如果科罗拉多州议会变天成了共和党掌控，我在那儿做不了堕胎手术怎么办？

sentences.en: Or what if abortions become illegal at the national level?
sentences.zh: 或者如果全国范围内的堕胎手术变得不合法了怎么办？

sentences.en: And I feel like after everything I've gone through with the clinic, after everything all of us went through, I need to live in a place where I have rights right now.
sentences.zh: 而且我觉得，经历了诊所的这一切之后，经历了我们所有人的这一切之后，我需要住在现在就拥有权利的地方。

sentences.en: And I need to live in a place where I can do my job.
sentences.zh: 我需要住在能让我开展工作的地方。

sentences.en: And I can like breathe for a while and not have to look over my shoulder.
sentences.zh: 我能像松一口气一样休息一段时间，不用整天提心吊胆。

sentences.en: The light at the end of the tunnel for me, I finally have like this little dim light of I could be doing abortions again.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，隧道尽头的曙光，我终于看到了一点微弱的光芒，那就是我或许能重新做堕胎手术了。

sentences.en: And, you know, I could maybe be doing abortions again and be really happy.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，我可能真的可以重新做堕胎手术，并且感到非常快乐。

sentences.en: I wanted to ask you, before I let you go, about how you're thinking right now about abortion access in the
sentences.zh: 在让你离开之前，我想问问你，目前你对

sentences.en: United States.
sentences.zh: 美国的堕胎获取权是怎么看的？

sentences.en: And we've talked a lot about your excitement about going to the UK and leaving the US, but like, you're leaving the US in what state?
sentences.zh: 我们讨论了很多你对去英国以及离开美国的兴奋之情，但话说回来，你离开美国时，这里的状况是怎样的？

sentences.en: I mean, how do you see the current situation with abortion?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，你是如何看待当前堕胎现状的？

sentences.en: I think we're in a bad state.
sentences.zh: 我认为我们现在处境糟糕。

sentences.en: And I don't know that people everywhere even realize how bad it is, right?
sentences.zh: 而且我不知道各地的人们是否意识到了情况有多糟，对吧？

sentences.en: Because some places, it might feel normal, but other places, it really doesn't.
sentences.zh: 因为在某些地方，感觉可能还算正常，但在其他地方，真的非常不正常。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: All of my anger has turned to really profound grief.
sentences.zh: 我所有的愤怒都转化为了极其深重的悲痛。

sentences.en: Since I left, it's grief for the patients and
sentences.zh: 自从我离开后，这悲痛是为患者而发，也是为了

sentences.en: the people here.
sentences.zh: 这里的民众。

sentences.en: I mean, my neighbors and their children and their little girls.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，为了我的邻居、他们的孩子和他们的小女儿。

sentences.en: Well, I mean, I'm really grieving for the people of Texas and I don't see a way it's going to change.
sentences.zh: 好吧，我的意思是，我真的在为得克萨斯州的人民感到悲伤，而且我看不到有什么办法能改变这一切。

sentences.en: I feel that I will gain some perspective by being away for a little bit, doing my job in a different set of scenarios.
sentences.zh: 我觉得通过离开一段时间，在不同的情境下做好我的工作，我会获得一些新的视角。

sentences.en: I'm hoping that I can like in the next chapter of my life, try to learn and take something away that if I were to come back, we got to be doing something different.
sentences.zh: 我希望在人生的下一个阶段，我能试着去学习并带走一些经验，如果我要回来，我们必须做出改变。

sentences.en: I just don't know what it is.
sentences.zh: 我只是不知道那会是什么。

sentences.en: Jess, it's so nice to talk to you.
sentences.zh: 杰丝，和你聊天太高兴了。

sentences.en: It's been really great talking with you.
sentences.zh: 和你交谈真的很棒。

sentences.en: You sound better.
sentences.zh: 你听起来状态好多了。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Yeah, I'm getting much better.
sentences.zh: 对，我恢复得好多了。
